content.title: Implement --branch flag for agt init + worktree refactor
content.description:
Implement the configurable branch name feature per spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md

## Scope
1. **src/core/worktree.ts** — Replace hardcoded WORKTREE_BRANCH/WORKTREE_DIR constants with:
   - DEFAULT_BRANCH/DEFAULT_DIR constants
   - normalizeBranchName(input) function
   - resolveWorktreePaths(cwd) function  
   - getWorktreeDir(branch) function
   - Update all worktree functions to accept { branch, dir } params (Option 2 from spec: WorktreeOptions interface)

2. **src/cli/init.ts** — Parse --branch flag, validate & normalize, pass to worktree init, store branch in config.json

3. **src/cli/push.ts** — Resolve branch from config instead of hardcoded constant

4. **src/cli/pull.ts** — Resolve branch from config instead of hardcoded constant

5. **src/types/config.ts** (or wherever Config interface lives) — Add optional branch field

6. **Gitignore handling** — Dynamic gitignore entry based on actual directory name

7. **Error codes** — INVALID_BRANCH_NAME and BRANCH_CONFLICT

## Key Design Decisions
- During init, pass branch explicitly (chicken-and-egg: config doesn't exist yet)
- Backward compatible: config without branch field = _agentrack default
- Use WorktreeOptions interface { branch: string; dir: string } for function signatures
- Normalization: strip leading underscores from user input, prepend _ for branch, . for dir

## Acceptance Criteria
See spec AC1-AC7 in .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md
